title: Pacemaker follow-up documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documenting that a transmission was triaged and reviewed by qualified staff, signed off, communicated, and linked to an already decided follow-up action.
user_facing_items.population: People with cardiovascular implantable electronic devices enrolled in in-clinic or remote device follow-up.
user_facing_items.setting: Cardiac device clinics, remote monitoring programs, data triage, alert review, documentation, communication, and follow-up.
restrictions: Exact for documenting CIED enrollment and connectivity context, scheduled and unscheduled transmissions, data review, alerts, qualified sign-off, communication, and follow-up. It does not interpret device data, program alerts, diagnose an event, or generate a treatment or emergency plan.
user_facing_items.rationale: The multisociety device-clinic statement supports documenting device-follow-up context, transmission or in-clinic data review, qualified sign-off, communication, and arranged follow-up without interpreting device findings.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recording received alerts, priority assigned by a qualified clinic, review, communication, and emergency-system limitations without generating alert programming, urgency, diagnosis, or treatment.
